request: Pull monthly federal employment counts from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Public Data API (CES Federal employment series across the major federal branches: total federal, executive postal, total non-postal civilian, DOD civilian, military), 2018-2025. Enrich with year-over-year change, 12-month rolling averages, z-score anomalies, and lifetime ranks. Publish to a 'Prep Agent / 02 - Federal Workforce' project on Tableau Server for HR analysts to track federal headcount trends.

sources.name: BLS CES Federal Employment
sources.description: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Public Data API v2 - Current Employment Statistics (CES) federal subsector. Five series codes covering Federal civilian (CES9091000001), Federal Postal (CES9091912001), Federal Government (CES9091000001), Federal Excluding Postal (CES9091000010), and total non-postal Federal (CES9091000010). Monthly cadence, jan-2018 onward. Public, keyless (rate-limited to 25 queries/day per IP without a registration key, plenty for monthly demos).

args.name: Workforce Trend
args.features_description: Adds row-level temporal features parsed from obs_date (year, month, quarter, fiscal_year, day_of_week, iso_week). Pure pass-through of the BLS observation rows.
args.stats_description: Long-form monthly workforce statistics by BLS series ID: monthly_count, 365-day rolling counts, year-over-year deltas with pct change, z-score anomalies vs lifetime baseline (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True), lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Use to identify employment-trend inflections within a series.

outputs.name: Federal Workforce Detail
outputs.description: Row-level monthly federal employment observations (one row per BLS series x month). Includes seriesID, year, period (M01-M12), periodName, value (employment in thousands), obs_date, plus calendar features: year, month, quarter, fiscal_year, day_of_week_name, iso_week. Source: BLS Public Data API CES federal subsector. Refresh: monthly.

outputs.name: Federal Workforce Stats
outputs.description: Long-form federal-employment statistics (one row per BLS series x year x month) with 365-day rolling counts, year-over-year deltas + pct change, z-score anomalies vs lifetime baseline (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True), and lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Joinable from Tableau on (dimension='seriesID', value, year, month). Source: BLS Public Data API CES federal subsector.
